scripts.build:ui: corepack pnpm --filter @markup/ui build 2>nul || echo ui is source-only
scripts.build:electron: corepack pnpm --filter @markup/electron run build:renderer && corepack pnpm --filter @markup/electron run build:main && corepack pnpm --filter @markup/electron exec electron-builder --dir
scripts.wails:build: corepack pnpm --filter @markup/wails-frontend run build && go build -C apps/wails -ldflags "-H windowsgui" -o markup-wails.exe .
